payload.comment: Architecture research stage is internally consistent and well-structured. All deterministic checks pass (empty deterministic_findings list). Key verifications: (1) 28×28×3 RGB shape confirmed across data_profile, representation_plan, and architecture_research. (2) Class counts sum correctly: train=89996, val=10004; imbalance ratio 12885/7886≈1.634 matches reported 1.633908. (3) Transformer tokenization math is correct: 7×7 stride-7 on 28×28 → 4×4=16 tokens; 14×14 stride-14 → 2×2=4 tokens. (4) Channel statistics (mean [0.741,0.533,0.706], std [0.124,0.177,0.124]) are consistent between data_profile and representation_plan. (5) augmented_train_size 359984 = 89996×4 matches augmentation_factor=4. (6) test_metrics_used=false confirms no test-set leakage. (7) Parameter budgets (0.5–4M primary, 11M upper-bound) are appropriate for 28×28 pathology patches. (8) Hyperparameter ranges (LR, weight decay, batch size, depth) are standard and well-justified for this problem scale. (9) Risk analysis covers overfitting, imbalance, spatial resolution loss, channel asymmetry, transformer instability, and calibration—comprehensive. Non-blocking observations: (a) Six arXiv evidence-source URLs (including 2507.12248v1 and 2508.18509v1) are external references that cannot be content-verified from this pipeline; they should be spot-checked before being cited in any final report. (b) Extension-gate entries hflip_pathology_safe and compact_conv_token_transformer remain pending_review while the representation_plan already lists hflip and the architecture_research proposes compact_transformer; ensure gate approval is recorded before training begins. (c) llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8, so LLM-assisted planning steps are not fully content-addressed (informational). None of these constitute deterministic failures; the stage output is sound and ready to proceed to implementation.
